inclusions: Private vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing as per the itinerary.

days.title: Day 1 – Chennai Arrival – Srikalahasti – Kanchipuram
activities: Meet and greet with our representative.
Offer prayers to Lord Shiva representing the Air Element (Vayu).
Visit Bharadwaja Tirtham, subject to time availability.

days.title: Day 2 – Kanchipuram Sightseeing – Tiruvannamalai
activities: Offer prayers to Lord Shiva representing the Earth Element (Prithvi).
Visit Kailasanathar Temple, subject to time availability.
Evening free for relaxation or local exploration.

days.title: Day 3 – Tiruvannamalai Sightseeing
activities: Offer prayers to Lord Shiva representing the Fire Element (Agni).
Visit Virupaksha Cave, subject to time availability.
Visit Skandashram, subject to time availability.
In the evening, experience the spiritual atmosphere around Arunachala Hill.
Optional Girivalam / temple circumambulation, depending on guest preference and physical comfort.

days.title: Day 4 – Tiruvannamalai to Chidambaram
activities: Breakfast and check out from the hotel.
Arrive and check in to the hotel.
Offer prayers to Lord Shiva representing the Space / Ether Element (Akasha).
Visit Pichavaram Mangrove Forest, subject to time availability and guest preference.

days.title: Day 5 – Chidambaram to Thiruvanaikaval – Trichy
activities: Breakfast and check out from the hotel.
Offer prayers to Lord Shiva representing the Water Element (Jala).
Visit Ucchi Pillayar Temple at Rockfort, subject to time availability.
Proceed to the hotel and check in.

days.title: Day 6 – Trichy and Srirangam Sightseeing
activities: Visit Uraiyur Vekkali Amman Temple, subject to time availability.
Visit Rockfort Temple, if not covered on the previous day.
Evening free for local exploration or shopping.

days.title: Day 7 - Departure
activities: Breakfast and check out from the hotel.
Drop at Trichy/Chennai Airport/Railway Station for onward journey.
